test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Decide which of the given conclusions is/are true based on the given statement.

**Statement:**

W = H ≥ G = C ≥ T ≤ L ≤ M

**Conclusions:**

I. T ≤ W

II.C ≥ M

options.text: Both conclusions I and II are true
Neither conclusion I nor II is true

solution:
**Conclusions:**

 
• I. T ≤ W → True (T ≤ C = G ≤ H = W)
 
• II.C ≥ M → False (the relationship between C and M cannot be determined as C ≥ T ≤ L ≤ M)

Thus, only conclusion I is true.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.
